source: recovered from JS5 index 12 clientscript name hashes (java 31-polynomial over the cp1252 bytes of "[category,name]")
ambiguous_note: 32-bit hash collisions: every listed candidate hashes to that script's name hash. Where one candidate is a hash-artifact spelling (start/stat6, op/q2, stars/stat5, tp/v2) or an incoherent token mash-up, the readable one is used in entries; the two ids absent from entries stay unnamed because both candidates are plausible.
